entities.summary: Burak Fırat is a Turkish chess player who received the FIDE title of Grandmaster (GM) in 2017. Fırat is the eleventh player to become a grandmaster in Turkish chess history. He previously received the FIDE Master (FM) title in 2009 and International Master (IM) in 2010.
